status_semantics.VERIFIED_MAIN: Requires executable/source/test/receipt evidence on current main or merged lineage.
status_semantics.VERIFIED_PROCESS: Requires exact provider/GitHub process evidence but may not be runtime code.
status_semantics.PARTIAL_MAIN: Some semantics are implemented on main, but the full canon rule is not proven.
status_semantics.PARTIAL_RESEARCH: Research evidence exists, but it is not production/current runtime authority.
status_semantics.RESEARCH_ONLY: Research-only evidence; never count as production implementation.
status_semantics.RESEARCH_ONLY_PARTIAL: Partial research mechanism; never count as production implementation.
status_semantics.GAP: Canon invariant was not found in bounded current TRIAXIS evidence.
status_semantics.GAP_OR_OUTSIDE: May be missing or may belong to another subsystem boundary.
status_semantics.OUTSIDE_TRIAXIS_CORE: Belongs to the cross-system Control Plane rather than TRIAXIS alone.

fail_closed_rules: Do not upgrade draft PR behavior to main.
Do not upgrade research hypotheses to production current.
Do not treat PREPARED as external effect completion.
Do not infer repository-wide complete mediation from one protected path.
Do not infer production qualification from component test PASS.
Do not mutate runtime/provider/trading/capital state from this profile.

entries.assertion: Risk is consequence-derived and caller downgrade is rejected.
Reference effect paths preserve PREPARED/STOP ceilings, but D010 is broader than TRIAXIS-specific stopping semantics.

entries.evidence: external heads, execution ledger, provider reconciliation, completion witnesses
entries.assertion: External durable evidence can dominate local state where the corresponding authority remains current.
Controls strengthen with consequence class; critical domains floor to R4.
Independent evidence and direct falsification are research mechanisms, not production authority.
Unavailable integration/runtime capabilities remain explicit non-claims.
PREPARED/COMPLETED/UNKNOWN/reconciled states prevent collapsing preparation into verified effect.
Reproduced failures are repaired by changed mechanisms and evidence rather than silent retry.

entries.evidence: bounded PR bodies and validation receipts
entries.assertion: Performed validation, absent validation, residuals, and non-goals are reported separately.
Artifacts and state are integrity-bound before use.

entries.evidence: exact baseline SHAs in bounded gates
entries.assertion: High-change work freezes an exact baseline before delta work.
State drift is detected in several subsystems, but no unified goal/intent/authority drift ledger is proven.
Small deltas over verified bases are preserved rather than wholesale rebuilds.

entries.evidence: authenticated in-process example and explicit non-claims
entries.assertion: Simulation/reference validation is not counted as real provider effect.

entries.evidence: versioned control-stack releases and validation receipts
entries.assertion: Continuity is strongly versioned, but one universal inherited-component manifest is not proven for every modern increment.
Historical receipts are preserved, but canonical-current promotion semantics are not a native TRIAXIS mechanism.

entries.evidence: not verified in bounded current evidence
entries.assertion: No generic auth/rate-limit friction adaptation mechanism is proven here.

entries.evidence: credential-aware references and explicit integration requirements
entries.assertion: Secret-custody requirements exist, but full secret-store enforcement was not proven in this profile.
UNKNOWN/IN_FLIGHT/COMPLETED block replay; retry requires authoritative NO_EFFECT reconciliation where supported.
TRIAXIS alone cannot prove the broader operator hub and subsystem dataflow.
Research uses state/context to evidence/instrument/verification hierarchy, but not the full operator rule.
Effect completion is evidenced, but generic delegated-agent return transport plus acceptance is not proven.
Outcome, evidence discipline, instrument validity, and confirmation quality are separated in research evidence.
Review evidence does not itself authorize merge/deploy/effect mutation.
TRIAXIS is one governance component and cannot alone prove Control Center + ContinuityOS + Return Plane composition.
